title: [PTRun][Calculator] Persist copied results without a post-write OLE flush

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The original guarded MSBuild projection failed with a fatal CsWinRT child exit, despite zero helper/MSBuild exits. A separately authorized control using the same pinned executable and response inputs with a new output directory succeeded and generated a file byte-identical to the existing production output. Both attempts released their exclusive locks. The comparison has an important confounder: the failure used MSBuild Exec, whereas the success launched CsWinRT directly from a different working directory. The failed output path was 263 characters long. Neither path length nor invocation context is established as the cause, and no PR defect is proven. A matched-path direct-launch discriminator is prepared but unrun; downstream validation remains incomplete.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
